# mooncake metrics

Display live system metrics (CPU/GPU/memory/load/network)

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
| `--query / -q` | []string | - | Query a specific metric by key (e.g. cpu_usage_pct). Repeatable. |
| `--fields` | []string | - | Restrict output to these keys. Repeatable or comma-separated. Adds a _collected_at sibling map. |
| `--refresh` | bool | false | Force re-sample, bypassing TTL |
| `--output / -o` | string | - | Save metrics to file (JSON) |
